top_signals.title: Gold Falls as Higher Oil Fuels Inflation Fears Ahead of Fed Meet
top_signals.summary: Gold declined as escalating Middle East hostilities sent oil surging ahead of a Federal Reserve policy meeting, while a selloff in equities added to broader market volatility.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Qatar Agrees to Buy US LNG to 2054 as War Disrupts Own Supply
top_signals.summary: QatarEnergy signed a deal with Cheniere Energy Inc. to buy 4 million tons a year of liquefied natural gas through 2054, the Middle East nation’s first such US offtake deal as its own production has been throttled by the Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Stocks Slip as Risk-Off Sentiment Dominates With Oil Rising
top_signals.summary: Stocks opened lower on Thursday as escalating concern about Mideast conflict pushed oil futures higher, spurring inflation fears with US midterm elections less than two weeks away. Investors were also parsing the latest batch of tech earnings for evidence that massive spending on AI is paying off.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Brent crude tops $112 after Trump says no negotiations with Iran, something will happen 'fairly soon'
top_signals.summary: The Middle East conflict could flare up again as the U.S. reportedly plans to resume strikes against Iran.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Typhoon Champi Shuts Taiwan’s $5 Trillion Stock Market
top_signals.summary: Taiwan’s stock exchange will shut Friday as Typhoon Champi approaches the island, bringing heavy rainfall and strong winds and prompting authorities to shut offices and schools in capital city Taipei.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Shell and Exxon’s $8bn UK chemicals unit put up for sale
top_signals.summary: Infineum taps advisers at Bank of America to run a sale of the business as Shell focuses on core oil and gas operations
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
